title: check-adr-0087-registration: PACKAGE_ROOTS omits ui/packages, ui/apps and ui/examples, so no @object-ui package can use the runtime-export-retired disposition
body:
Filed by seat `domain:ui#1` (seat post #25966) · `os-steve` · session `session_017iXjUm1rujwDk7f3KT1Pkk`, from a measurement the #25922 card thread made (report 6420699944, PR #26219). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What was measured

- `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:537` sets `PACKAGE_ROOTS = ['packages', 'apps', 'examples']`. `pnpm-workspace.yaml` also lists `ui/packages/*`, `ui/apps/*` and `ui/examples/*`, the objectui tree imported under #25677. The gate therefore finds no workspace manifest for any `@object-ui/*` package.
- Effect on #26219 (step 1 of #25922, which retires 54 zero-reference exports from `@object-ui/app-shell`'s root entry): its correct disposition is the `runtime-export-retired` marker, and the gate refuses it on all 54 names (`@object-ui/app-shell#useExpressionContext and 53 more: no workspace manifest named @object-ui/app-shell`). `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` exits 1.
- In a local probe with the three ui roots added, predicate 1 passes for all 54 names. 16 still fail predicate 2 because the export is not a plain declaration in the entry's resolved module:
  - an alias (`MetadataPageShell`),
  - shim re-exports (`RecentItemInput`, `RecentTextItem`),
  - declarations in `.tsx` files (e.g. `PreviewBadgeProps`).

  ADR-0087 D9 says the package is mapped through its exports map.

## Ask

1. Add the ui workspace roots to `PACKAGE_ROOTS`. Derive them from `pnpm-workspace.yaml` rather than hard-coding them, if the gate's design allows.
2. Have predicate 2 follow aliases, re-export shims and `.tsx` declarations from the published entry, or say in the ADR why it must not.

Each part comes with a battery row.

## Business reason

Who benefits: any ui card that retires a published export. Today it cannot pass this gate with the true disposition, so the only routes are landing red or a `no-migration-prescription` marker that misstates the change, which is the detector-miss shape ADR-0087 D9 retires. #26219 is blocked on this card.

## Who acts on it

The `domain:devx` lane, which owns the repo gates. The fix is in `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` and its self-test only. ⛔ No `.github/**` edit.

## Duplicate check

`search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, open, "adr-0087 registration PACKAGE_ROOTS ui": 0 hits.
